caption: The drawing depicts a tray-like object with a scalloped, wavy-edged base that is hexagonal or octagonal in shape, rendered mostly in gray tones with shading to indicate depth and metallic texture. Rising from two opposing corners of the tray are two turned, spindle-shaped vertical supports, each connected at the top by a horizontal, slightly curved panel. This panel features a row of circular cut-outs and below them, a twisted rope-like decorative element running horizontally. The background of the image is a plain beige color, and there are some scale references, measurements, and annotations along the lower margin, suggesting the tray’s dimensions (16 x 16 inches, height 9 inches). There is a smudge or stain near the top edge of the drawing. The entire composition is enclosed within a single-line border.
title: Foot Scraper
